description: Enhanced boundary coverage for ARC reads (native-disjoint). The library's read projection for an arc reports the underlying circle fields (center, radius, normal, thickness) and omits the angle fields, exactly as the native suite demonstrates. These cases vary radius-only, fractional center, and a negative-Z normal while still supplying angle group codes in the input to confirm they do not appear in the typed read.
